gi_native_drawing.locator: Manual PDF page 65, DOC-002 Solenoid Wiring; native 300-dpi upright render. Full GI contact/feed/return context including PP1-13 beyond the compact crop. Footer voltage digit remains uncertain between 5 and 6 VAC; special-insert count digit is uncertain between 4 and 6. Coin-door count 2-4 and pre-contact F21 feed checked directly.

projection_classes.reason: 17/18 project onto Drain/BallRelease; under-apron switch brackets are not separately modeled.
Kicker,plunger,bumper,sling,bank reset and gate outputs project onto their own fixed mechanism; no measured under-playfield coil center is claimed.

AllLights TimerInterval binds illumination objects. Independent factory drawing checks can validate feature anchors; they do not establish under-playfield socket centers. Bumper39/40 and billboard59/60 remain candidates.

excluded_helpers.GI groups: UpperGILights (25 objects) and LowerGILights (14 objects) cannot settle the conflicting physical regions or candidate branch counts; no GI placements are published.
excluded_helpers.flasher helpers: a/b glow doubles collapse to b only when show_bulb_mesh; F23a/b lack bulb mesh. Sprites/dome skins are excluded.
excluded_helpers.off-table helpers: F17a001/F17b001 lie far outside bounds and are excluded without clamping.
excluded_helpers.invisible flipper: LeftFlipper1 is a real upper-left assembly: script motion and factory circuit/parts establish fitment.
excluded_helpers.cabinet button lights: Only lamps47/48 illuminate cabinet Start/Shooter buttons;57-61 are playfield billboard lamps, as DOC-004 explicitly spells out.

blockers.reason: Unresolved conflict gi-region-16-26: same-manual load drawing versus coil-table physical-region assignments; no source is silently promoted.
blockers.would_resolve: Owner/technician wired socket survey or physical-machine service video linking both public selectors to actual bulbs.

blockers.reason: The special-insert drawing count digit is degraded and uncertain between 4 and 6, followed by BULBS. A separate parallel branch has two unlabelled bulb symbols; the count annotation scope also does not settle the total. The footer voltage digit remains uncertain between 5 and 6 VAC. No typed quantity or voltage is promoted.
blockers.would_resolve: Clearer factory source or original-machine backbox socket survey settling the count and its scope; verified machine supply information is needed for the degraded footer voltage digit.

blockers.reason: The load drawing assigns 16 to 26 top-playfield bulbs and 26 to 12 bottom-playfield bulbs, while the coil table, observed ROM labels and VPX assign opposite regions. Another 2-4 coin-door bulbs share the F21 supply before its relay contact and are unswitched cabinet context. Per-address controlled playfield regions, quantities and wired socket groups remain unresolved.
blockers.would_resolve: Original-machine wired socket survey or physical-machine service video linking selectors 16/26 to all their controlled playfield bulbs; another virtual ROM label trace cannot settle physical wiring.

blockers.reason: Two-bulb branches17/18/19/22 have only one modeled bulb center each; Pit/Lock23 has glow helpers but no modeled bulb.
blockers.would_resolve: Socket-level photos or factory geometry identifying every emitter, reconciled against the exact table.

blockers.reason: Bumper lamps39/40 are excluded from the drawing check because their outlines are fit controls. Billboard59/60 fail one or both independent drawing-fit limits; their table anchors remain candidates.
blockers.would_resolve: Independent physical lamp positions or a clearer factory socket layout; preserve failed fit results instead of moving pixels toward VPX.
